answer: Grading junk as passing is hence a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. The nectar panel is drawn blind, the reef escrow settles at close, and relic lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 17% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 164 account operation therefore ties up 31 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
